verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents that stack traces can link directly to the line of code, but only on some platforms and in the context of releases rather than explicitly the default branch. Its path-based automatic assignment rules (e.g. src/components/cart → Cart Team) give an ownership-like capability, but these are rules configured in BugSnag, not repo code owners. missing for 10: documented repository connection, suspect-commit identification on issues, code-owners integration from the repo, explicit default-branch line linking across platforms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
